name: serverest-api-tests
description: API test automation for ServeRest with Postman collections generated from code and run by Newman

scripts.server:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && bash scripts/wait-for-server.sh
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:regression && npm run test:validation
scripts.test:regression: newman run postman/regression.postman_collection.json -e environments/local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/regression.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "ServeRest - Regression" --reporter-junit-export reports/regression.xml
scripts.test:validation: newman run postman/validation.postman_collection.json -e environments/local.postman_environment.json -d data/invalid-users.csv -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/validation.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "ServeRest - User validation (data-driven)" --reporter-junit-export reports/validation.xml
scripts.test:known-issues: newman run postman/known-issues.postman_collection.json -e environments/local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/known-issues.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "ServeRest - Known issues"
